components.name: StBox
components.description: A surface with token-only padding, border, ring, radius, and shadow. Layout wrapper for cards, panels, and wells.

props.name: border
props.description: A real border of this emphasis.

props.name: ring
props.description: An inset edge of this emphasis that does not change layout.

components.example:
<StBox surface="sunken" :radius="150" :padding="150">
  <StStack :gap="100">
    <StBox
      v-for="n in 3"
      :key="n"
      surface="raised"
      ring="subtle"
      :radius="100"
      :padding="100"
    >
      {{ n }}
    </StBox>

components.name: StButton
components.description: A text button. Variants primary, secondary, ghost, link, and danger; sizes sm, md, lg; `loading` disables it and marks it busy.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `secondary`.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables the button and marks it busy.

components.name: StCheckbox
components.description: A checkbox with a label slot. v-model is a boolean; Space toggles it.
keyboard: Checkbox toggles with Space
components.example: <StCheckbox v-model="keep">Keep generated summaries with my history</StCheckbox>

components.name: StDialog
components.description: A modal window on the native dialog element: it fills the window as the scrim and holds your panel in its slot. Escape and a click on the scrim emit `dismiss`; focus is trapped inside and returns to the opener.

props.name: open
props.description: Mount it open, or toggle it. Default true, so `v-if` on the parent opens and closes it.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, unless `labelledby` points at a visible heading.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the panel sits: centered, or near the top like a command palette.

props.name: scrim
props.description: `dim` darkens the window behind it; `clear` leaves it visible, for settings that preview.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Escape and a click on the scrim ask to dismiss.

props.name: focus
props.description: Where focus starts: the first control (default), or the dialog itself so its title is read first.

keyboard: Dialog opens modal, keeps Tab inside, closes on Escape, and returns focus
Dialog closed by unmounting it still returns focus to the opener
Dialog: a press on the scrim dismisses it, a press inside does not
Escape closes only the top layer: a menu in a dialog before the dialog
components.example:
<StDialog
    id="demo-dialog"
    :open="dialogOpen"
    label="Rename note"
    @dismiss="dialogOpen = false"
  >
    <StBox surface="raised" border="subtle" :radius="200" shadow="lg" :padding="300">
      <StStack :gap="200">
        <StText as="h4" kind="headline" size="sm">Rename note</StText>
        <StInput v-model="dialogName" label="Name" />
        <StStack direction="row" align="center" justify="between" :gap="100">
          <StButton
            id="demo-dialog-menu-button"
            ref="dialogMenuButton"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-haspopup="menu"
            @click="dialogMenuOpen = !dialogMenuOpen"
          >
            More
          </StButton>
          <StStack direction="row" :gap="100">
            <StButton id="demo-dialog-cancel" @click="dialogOpen = false">Cancel</StButton>
            <StButton variant="primary" @click="dialogOpen = false">Rename</StButton>
          </StStack>
        </StStack>
      </StStack>
    </StBox>
    <StMenu
      id="demo-dialog-menu"
      :open="dialogMenuOpen"
      :anchor="(dialogMenuButton as unknown as { $el: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el"
      label="More"
      @dismiss="dialogMenuOpen = false"
    >
      <StMenuItem>Duplicate</StMenuItem>
      <StMenuItem>Move…</StMenuItem>
    </StMenu>
  </StDialog>

components.name: StDisclosure
components.description: A native details element whose body glides open, with a chevron and a `summary` slot. v-model:open.
keyboard: Disclosure toggles with Enter and Space
components.example:
<StDisclosure id="demo-disclosure" v-model:open="disclosureOpen">
    <template #summary>Details</template>
    <StText as="p" kind="body" size="md" tone="secondary">
      The body glides open. It is a native details element, so find-in-page and the keyboard
      work as expected.
    </StText>
  </StDisclosure>

components.name: StField
components.description: A form field wrapper: label, hint, and error wired to the control by id and aria-describedby. Pass the control through the default slot, which receives { id, describedby, invalid }.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message. It replaces nothing: the hint stays, and the control is marked invalid.

components.example:
<StField label="Location" hint="Where Ryte keeps your notes.">
    <template #default="field">
      <StInput
        :id="field.id"
        v-model="boxed"
        :aria-describedby="field.describedby"
        :invalid="field.invalid"
      />
    </template>
  </StField>

components.name: StIconButton
components.description: A square button with one icon. Requires `label`, which is its accessible name and tooltip. The default slot overlays content on the icon, such as a shortcut badge.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `ghost`.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. An icon button has no visible text, so this is required.

components.name: StInput
components.description: A text input. Variants boxed (forms), inline (renaming in place, takes the font of what it replaces), and bare (no chrome, such as a search box). Exposes focus() and select(start, end).

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `boxed`.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`.

props.name: type
props.description: Default `text`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as wrong: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. Required when there is no visible label.

components.name: StMenu
components.description: A menu in the top layer, anchored to an element or a rect such as the pointer. Arrows, Home, End, and typing move through its items; Tab and Escape close it; choosing an item emits `dismiss` with reason select.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name.

keyboard: Escape closes only the top layer: a menu in a dialog before the dialog
Menu: arrows, Home/End and wrapping skip disabled items
Menu: typing jumps to the next item starting with that letter
Menu: a space typed while jumping does not activate the item
Menu: Enter chooses, closes the menu, and returns focus to the trigger
Menu: Tab and Escape close it; a press outside closes it; the trigger toggles
Context menu opens at the pointer and closes on Escape
components.example:
<StMenu
    id="demo-dialog-menu"
    :open="dialogMenuOpen"
    :anchor="(dialogMenuButton as unknown as { $el: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el"
    label="More"
    @dismiss="dialogMenuOpen = false"
  >
    <StMenuItem>Duplicate</StMenuItem>
    <StMenuItem>Move…</StMenuItem>
  </StMenu>

components.name: StMenuItem
components.description: An item of StMenu. Role menuitem, or menuitemradio and menuitemcheckbox with `checked`. Tone danger for destructive actions.

props.name: role
props.description: `menuitemradio` marks a single choice among several; pair it with `checked`.

keyboard: Menu: arrows, Home/End and wrapping skip disabled items
Menu: Enter chooses, closes the menu, and returns focus to the trigger

components.name: StMenuLabel
components.description: A non-interactive heading inside StMenu, such as "Sort by".

components.name: StMenuSeparator
components.description: A thin line between groups of menu items.

components.name: StNotice
components.description: A message about the state of something. Tones info, success, warning, danger; boxed or inline; optional title, dismiss button, and actions slot. Danger announces as an alert, the rest as status.

props.name: tone
props.description: Default `info`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default `boxed`.

props.name: title
props.description: A bold line above the message.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button and emits `dismiss`.

props.name: urgent
props.description: Announce it right away (`alert`) instead of politely (`status`). Danger defaults to urgent.

components.example:
<StNotice v-for="tone in NOTICE_TONES" :key="tone" :tone="tone">
    A {{ tone }} notice explains the state of something.
  </StNotice>

components.name: StPopover
components.description: A floating panel in the top layer, placed next to an anchor (an element or a rect). Escape and a press outside emit `dismiss`; focus returns to the opener.

props.name: anchor
props.description: What it is placed next to: an element, or a rect such as the pointer or a text selection.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name.

props.name: role
props.description: `dialog` for content, `menu` for a menu. Default `dialog`.

keyboard: Escape closes only the top layer: a menu in a dialog before the dialog
Context menu opens at the pointer and closes on Escape
Popover sits below its anchor, closes on Escape and outside press, and returns focus
Popover follows its anchor when the page scrolls
components.example:
<StPopover
    id="demo-popover"
    :open="popoverOpen"
    :anchor="(popoverButton as unknown as { $el: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el"
    label="Details"
    @dismiss="popoverOpen = false"
  >
    <StBox :padding="150">
      <StText as="p" kind="body" size="compact">Anchored to its button.</StText>
      <StInput label="Quick note" />
    </StBox>
  </StPopover>

components.name: StProse
components.description: Renders sanitized markdown HTML with Ryte reading typography. `html` must be output of the markdown renderer, never raw user input.

components.name: StSegmented
components.description: A radio group drawn as joined buttons. Arrows select as they move; Home and End jump; one tab stop.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the group.

keyboard: Segmented control moves and selects with arrows, Home and End; one tab stop

components.name: StSelect
components.description: A native select drawn like the boxed input, with a chevron. v-model is the value string.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. Required when there is no visible label.

components.name: StStack
components.description: A flex stack with token-only gap, direction, alignment, and wrapping.

props.name: direction
props.description: Default `column`.

components.name: StText
components.description: Text in a type role (`kind` and `size`) and tone, with optional weight, truncation, line clamp, and alignment. Renders a span unless `as` says otherwise.

props.name: kind
props.description: The kind of text, which picks the type role. Default `body`. Not `role`, which is the ARIA attribute.

props.name: size
props.description: Default `md`. A size the role does not offer falls back to `md`.

props.name: weight
props.description: Overrides the weight of the role.

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis.

props.name: lines
props.description: Clamp to this many lines.

components.name: StToaster
components.description: The region that shows toasts. Render it once near the root; fire toasts with `toast()` from toast-store.
keyboard: Toasts stack to three, announce by tone, and dismiss

components.name: StTooltip
components.description: A short label for a control. Shows after a hover pause or on keyboard focus and hides on Escape. The default slot receives { describedby } for the control.
keyboard: Tooltip shows on hover after a pause and on keyboard focus, and hides on Escape
components.example:
<StTooltip v-slot="{ describedby }" text="Refresh the list">
    <StIconButton
      id="demo-tooltip-trigger"
      icon="refresh"
      label="Refresh"
      :aria-describedby="describedby"
    />
  </StTooltip>

components.name: StIcon
components.description: An icon from the Stencil set, drawn as one filled currentColor shape. `name` is a generated icon name; `size` is in px.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in px. The drawing scales with it.

behaviors.name: anchored-position
behaviors.summary: Where a floating element goes relative to an anchor: on the requested side, flipped to the other side when it would not fit, and kept inside the viewport. The anchor is a plain rect, so it can be a pointer position, a text selection, or an element. Pure, so it runs in node tests.

behaviors.name: layer-stack
behaviors.summary: The open layers of the app, in the order they opened. Escape and outside clicks close only the top one, so a menu inside a dialog closes before the dialog does. Pure, so it runs in node tests.

behaviors.name: list-navigation
behaviors.summary: The active option of a list that keeps focus elsewhere (a combobox input). The list itself is driven by `aria-activedescendant`; `reveal` scrolls the active option into view.

behaviors.name: roving
behaviors.summary: Arrow-key movement through a row or column of items (menu, tabs, radio group, toolbar), with Home and End. The pure part is `rovingTarget`; `useRovingFocus` adds the DOM.

behaviors.name: typeahead
behaviors.summary: Type-to-jump in a list (menu, select, listbox). `typeaheadStep` keeps the typed buffer; `typeaheadMatch` finds the item. Pure, so both run in node tests.

behaviors.name: useAnchoredPosition
behaviors.summary: Places a floating element next to an anchor. The anchor can be an element or a plain rect, such as the pointer (a context menu) or a text selection (a comment popover). Call `update` after the floating element is rendered so its size is known.

behaviors.name: useDismissLayer
behaviors.summary: Registers an open overlay on the shared layer stack. While it is the top layer, Escape and a pointer press outside its elements ask it to dismiss. It never closes itself: `onDismiss` decides.

behaviors.name: useFocusReturn
behaviors.summary: Remembers what had focus when an overlay opened and gives it back when the overlay closes. Falls back to `fallback` when the opener is gone, so focus never drops to the page body.
